findings.source_quote: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose –Romans 8:28.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the quoted sentence with: “En ons weet dat alles ten goede meewerk vir dié wat God liefhet, dié wat volgens sy voorneme geroep is –Romeine 8:28.” This preserves the source’s wording without adding God as the explicit agent of “work together.”
findings.translation_quote: En ons weet dat God alles ten goede laat meewerk vir dié wat Hom liefhet, dié wat geroep is volgens sy voorneme –Romeine 8:28.
